# Dangling Pages Risk

If an owner of a page is removed or not found during emission, it may lead to dangling pages that cannot be properly processed, resulting in potential inconsistencies in the generated wiki.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/wiki/emitter.py` — `knowledge_compiler.wiki.emitter.WikiEmitter.emit`
